# HT Logistics Solutions

> Malaysian logistics company established in 2023, headquartered in Penang. Integrated warehousing, transportation, manpower supply, kitting, and packaging & labelling, delivered from five branches across Penang and Kulim.

## Key facts
- Legal name: HT Logistics Solutions Sdn Bhd (201101019426 / 1495599-H)
- Established: 2023. Headquarters: Penang, Malaysia
- Address: Plot 3, Hujung Perusahaan 1, 13600 Perai, Penang
- Phone: +60 4-399 7120 · Mobile/WhatsApp: +60 12-487 9121 · Email: admin@htlogisticssolutions.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 8.30am–5pm
- Scale: 50,000 m² warehouse capacity, 5 warehouse branches, 20 land vehicles, 200+ active workers
- Certifications: ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, TAPA, GDPMD

## Main facilities
- Science Park, Bukit Minyak, Pulau Pinang (HQ): 17,400 m², 4,000 pallet positions; bonded & non-bonded, temperature-controlled, cold storage
- Prai Industrial Park, Seberang Prai, Penang: 8,500 m², 6,000 pallet positions; bonded & non-bonded, temperature-controlled, ambient storage
- Kulim Industrial Park, Kulim, Kedah: 4,000 m², 4,000 pallet positions; bonded & non-bonded, temperature-controlled storage

## Services
- Core: Warehouse & Distribution, Kitting, Packaging & Labelling, Transportation, Manpower Supply
- Specialised: Supply Chain Solutions, Nationwide FTL & LTL Transport, Cross-Border Trucking, Last-Mile Delivery, Import/Export & Customs Support (incl. duty exemptions, HS Code registration, import permits, LMW applications), Pick & Pack Operations, Value-Added Services, Warehouse Management System (WMS), Transport Management System (TMS)

## Industries served
Manufacturing, automotive, retail, medical, electronics, FMCG, e-commerce, industrial
